segments.ja496:1.1: Sukhumālarūpaṃ disvā [disvāna (ka. sī. aṭṭha.)], raṭṭhā vivanamāgataṃ;
segments.ja496:2.1: Tassa te pemakenāhaṃ, adāsiṃ vaḍḍhamodanaṃ [baddhamodanaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja496:3.1: Taṃ tvaṃ bhattaṃ paṭiggayha, brāhmaṇassa adāsayi [adāpayi (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja496:3.3: Attānaṃ [attanā (pī. aṭṭha. pāṭhantaraṃ)] anasitvāna, koyaṃ dhammo namatthu te.
segments.ja496:4.3: Garu ca āmantanīyo [āmantaṇīyo (sī. pī.)] ca, dātumarahāmi bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja496:5.3: Rājā te bhattaṃ pādāsi, suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ.
segments.ja496:6.1: Taṃ tvaṃ bhattaṃ paṭiggayha, isissa bhojanaṃ adā;
segments.ja496:6.3: Akhettaññūsi dānassa, koyaṃ dhammo namatthu te.
segments.ja496:7.1: Bharāmi putta [putte (sī. pī.)] dāre ca, gharesu gadhito [gathito (sī. pī.)] ahaṃ;
segments.ja496:10.3: Bhikkhu kena tayā seyyo, yassa tvaṃ bhojanaṃ adā.
segments.ja496:11.1: Khaṇantālukalambāni [khaṇamālukalambāni (syā. ka.)], bilālitakkalāni ca [biḷālitakkaḷāni ca (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja496:11.3: Dhunaṃ sāmākanīvāraṃ, saṅghāriyaṃ pasāriyaṃ [saṃhāriyaṃ pahāriyaṃ (syā.), saṃsāriyaṃ pasāriyaṃ (ka.)].
segments.ja496:12.1: Sākaṃ bhisaṃ madhuṃ maṃsaṃ, badarāmalakāni ca;
segments.ja496:12.3: Tāni āharitvā [āhatva (sī. syā.)] bhuñjāmi, atthi me so pariggaho.
segments.ja496:14.3: Isi te bhattaṃ pādāsi, suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ.
segments.ja496:15.1: Taṃ tvaṃ bhattaṃ paṭiggayha, tuṇhī bhuñjasi ekako;
segments.ja496:15.3: Nāññaṃ kañci [kiñci (ka.)] nimantesi, koyaṃ dhammo namatthu te.
segments.ja496:16.1: Na pacāmi na pācemi, na chindāmi na chedaye;
segments.ja496:16.3: Taṃ maṃ akiñcanaṃ ñatvā, sabbapāpehi ārataṃ.
segments.ja496:17.3: Isi me bhattaṃ pādāsi, suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ.
segments.ja496:19.1: Atthāya vata me ajja, idhāgacchi rathesabho;
segments.ja496:19.3: Sohaṃ ajja pajānāmi [ito pubbe na jānāmi (sī. pī.)], yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja496:20.3: Isī mūlaphale giddhā, vippamuttā ca bhikkhavoti.
segments.ja496:24.1: Suva kinnara mukka kharājinaso, bhisajāta mahesi kapotavaro;
segments.ja496:24.3: Atha mora satacchaka vāṇijako, atha rāja sabrāhmaṇa bhikkhaparanti. Pakiṇṇakanipātaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
